roleTitle: Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.

In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for nursing staff, fostering continuous professional growth. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, overseeing surveillance, prevention strategies, and compliance with all regulatory guidelines. This full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and education within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00 based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Physical Therapist (PT) for a PRN opportunity at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This role offers the flexibility to manage your schedule while providing essential therapy services to patients.

As a PRN Physical Therapist, you will play a crucial role in patient recovery, developing and implementing individualized treatment plans to restore function and improve quality of life. Join a compassionate team committed to excellence in patient care.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rates ranging from $39.00 to $40.00 per hour, based on experience.

description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL, as a Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA). This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to patient recovery and well-being in a supportive environment, working full-time hours to make a significant impact. We are offering a competitive hourly rate ranging from $28.00 to $37.00, commensurate with your experience and qualifications. This role provides a chance to work alongside a passionate team committed to delivering high-quality rehabilitative care. If you are a motivated PTA looking for a rewarding full-time position where your skills are valued, we encourage you to apply. Take the next step in your career and help us enhance the lives of our residents.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) program
Current and valid state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA)
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
